reason: Enabling FIPS mode requires adding the dracut fips module and setting the kernel boot parameter fips=1, which involves bootloader/kernel changes. The policy states FIPS changes are classified as too dangerous to remediate on an existing system because they can cause system lockout or break critical services and are not supported on already installed systems.
estimated_impact: reboot required; FIPS mode activation; bootloader modification; kernel parameter change; potential system lockout
